THE_DEFECT_IS_IN_MY_APPROVAL_NOT_THE_RUN.what: The contract's reasoning, which I REPEATED VERBATIM IN THE APPROVAL, claims a PLATEAU outcome rejects under BOTH calibrations. That is false in the interval [0.003214927, 0.004780061), and D8 = 0.0043859 falls inside it: PLATEAU fires while the unequal-size two-sample test does NOT reject.
THE_DEFECT_IS_IN_MY_APPROVAL_NOT_THE_RUN.my_error: Both numbers appear in my own approval sentence and I did not notice the plateau edge sits below the two-sample critical value. I approved a robustness claim I had the arithmetic to falsify in front of me.
THE_DEFECT_IS_IN_MY_APPROVAL_NOT_THE_RUN.what_is_NOT_damaged: Under the calibration the contract DECIDED IN ADVANCE -- one-sample, chosen as the stricter reading -- D8 exceeds the critical value by 2.75x and the outcome is a rejection. The result stands under the contract's own framing.
THE_DEFECT_IS_IN_MY_APPROVAL_NOT_THE_RUN.what_IS_damaged: The claim that ARM 1 is calibration-robust. For this value the calibration question MATTERS -- which is the question BATCH-028 left open and which ARM 1 was designed to make moot. It did not make it moot. The reviewers must rule on the framing.
THE_DEFECT_IS_IN_MY_APPROVAL_NOT_THE_RUN.handled_correctly_by_the_executor: Applied the frozen band as written, reported the gap, adjusted nothing, reached for no tiebreaker, referred adjudication.

DISPATCHER_VERIFICATION_STATUS.corrective_action: Recorded as a correction in the ledger archive. The rule is extended: THE COORDINATOR'S OWN ARTIFACTS ARE SOURCE ARTIFACTS TOO. Every prior statement of this rule named producers and reviewers and did not name the Coordinator, which is the gap I fell through.
